architectureDecisions: D1 — DELIVER_SLICE_V1 carries optional permissionProfile/model. permissionProfile must be WORKSPACE_EDIT or FULL_AUTO; supplied model is nonempty string. Explicit null/empty/number/boolean/array/object rejects before processes. Only omission yields WORKSPACE_EDIT/null. Reject unrecognized manifest keys too; recognized current keys are id,repositoryRoot,baseRevision,prompt,tool,backendVerifications,qaVerifications,requiredFiles,recoveryDir,maxAttempts,timeoutMs plus these two fields. Already-delivered additive fields must retain their own validation; unknown fields never silently grant options. No widening tool-id parity.

D2 — Add deliver CLI --permission and --model; commandDeliverCli maps permissionProfile:options.permission and model:options.model only when supplied. Programmatic options use undefined for omission; explicit null/empty/non-string overrides reject before dispatch. Effective permission/model is supplied option, then manifest field, then WORKSPACE_EDIT/null. Manifest fields use D1 validation. CLI permission must be exact enum and model nonempty string. Update USAGE. No extra confirmation beyond existing run FULL_AUTO behavior. Add DELIVER_FLAGS whitelist slice,command,recovery-dir,permission,model; reject unknown CLI flags before manifest reading or tool resolution. runDeliverSlice/commandDeliver reject unrecognized programmatic option keys; recognized existing tool/command/recovery/env/maxAttempts/timeoutMs/onHandleWrite and aliases retain their validation.

D3 — Forward into Backend only. All runSupervisedTask and resumeSupervisedTask calls in runDeliverSlice pass permissionProfile and model. QA is unchanged. Import PermissionProfile from tool-adapters.js (already imported there).

D4 — Focused tests follow testContract. Reject every malformed declared manifest and programmatic override before fake dispatch, directly exercise validateDeliverSlice in bound N1/N3, and exercise runDeliverSlice with captured invocation for bound N2. Capture actual permission/model in fresh and durable-resume invocations, exact CLI argv and unchanged omitted defaults; success status alone cannot establish forwarding. Existing deliver tests remain green.

D5 — Living docs. operator.md manifest list gains optional permissionProfile and model, CLI --permission/--model, CLI-wins, default WORKSPACE_EDIT/null, unknown permission fails before spawn, no extra FULL_AUTO prompt. state.md operator deliver sentence names the same options. No Blackboard ids.
D6 — Evidence at 5386e2ad: discovery deliverMentionsPermissionProfile false, deliverMentionsModel false, runCliPassesPermission true, runCliPassesModel true.
implementationSlices: S1 — deliver-slice.js/bin CLI; OPTIONS_FORWARDED. validateDeliverSlice accepts optional permissionProfile and nonempty string model, defaults only on omission to WORKSPACE_EDIT/null, and returns normalized fields. runDeliverSlice validates supplied option values, selects options > slice > defaults, then adds permissionProfile/model to all three runSupervisedTask/resumeSupervisedTask call objects (durable fresh closure, no-recovery fresh path, interrupted resume). QA remains unchanged. commandDeliver accepts permission/permissionProfile and model, mapping them to normalized runDeliverSlice options; commandDeliverCli forwards options.permission/options.model instead of dropping them. Update DELIVER_FLAGS and USAGE. Preserve existing durable execution checks; an ACCEPTED-handle path runs QA without new Backend dispatch. Resume tests capture normalized buildInvocation request even when tool resume argv omits model/sandbox by delivered adapter design.

S2 — fail-closed fixtures; UNKNOWN_FAILS_CLOSED. Use exact allowlists per API: manifest id/repositoryRoot/baseRevision/prompt/tool/backendVerifications/qaVerifications/requiredFiles/recoveryDir/maxAttempts/timeoutMs/permissionProfile/model plus independently validated delivered additions; runDeliverSlice options tool/command/recoveryDir/maxAttempts/timeoutMs/env/onHandleWrite/permissionProfile/model; commandDeliver additionally slice, recovery-dir/max-attempts/timeout-ms/permission aliases. Reject unknown keys before manifest read/tool lookup/process dispatch at the appropriate boundary. Reject supplied null/empty/non-string model and permission outside exact enum; only undefined means omitted. Bound N1/N3 invoke validateDeliverSlice; N2 invokes runDeliverSlice omission, N4 unknown option cases exercise each API and actual CLI. Verify no dispatch/handle write on errors, option precedence, and real fresh/resume request fields. Current tool-id whitelist, verifier shapes and QA remain unchanged.
S3 — Living docs [OPTIONS_FORWARDED]: implement D5. operator.md and state.md name permission/model, CLI-wins, WORKSPACE_EDIT default, fail-before-spawn. No Blackboard ids.
